decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 with its own page, the cutting and creasing finisher's value is still uncertain, and as a distributed product it costs little to keep listed.
The UV spot varnishing system is a flagship whose German premiere signals strategic commitment, and enhancement demand is growing, so the option deserves further investment.
The sheet preparation module is a low-cost complement to the modular systems, and its prospects remain unresolved after one year, so the option stays open.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship central to the digital finishing direction, and early signals justify continued commitment.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making portfolio and costs little to keep while market response is still unfolding.
The folding add-on already has a reported customer installation that combines it with the Touchline system, which is positive evidence of value at low holding cost.
